scope: AI Chat production dropdowns matching Studio

browser.projectSelection: Blue Kiln opens its Profile/Chat/Thread route; its menu row has aria-current=page and a check glyph.
browser.newProject: Opens /en/ai-chat/projects with the Project name field and Create project action.
browser.keyboard: Enter opens the project menu. Escape closes it and restores focus to the Project trigger.
browser.agentSelection: Selecting Blue Kiln updates the Thread agent combobox.
browser.workingContext: Bookings selection updates the trigger and checked radio state. Source IDs remain the option values. Whole document is restored after verification.
